entities.name: B2KC48 LpxK
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed UniProt B2KC48 from Elusimicrobium minutum; annotated as tetraacyldisaccharide 4′-kinase (EC 2.7.1.130).
Transfers ATP’s terminal phosphate to the 4′ position of DS-1-P, producing lipid IVA; LpxK Pfam domain spans residues 18–350.

entities.name: LpxK lipid IVA reaction
observations: Rhea RHEA:67840: lipid A disaccharide + ATP → lipid IVA + ADP + H⁺; the enzyme phosphorylates the 4′ position of DS-1-P.

entities.name: Lipid A biosynthesis
observations: LpxK catalyzes the final step of lipid IVA biosynthesis in the lipid A biosynthetic process; linked annotations include GO:0009245 and GO:0009244.
